page.overview:
What is Germa Kingdom?

The Germa Kingdom, also known as the , is the world's only seafaring kingdom, and a former member nation of the World Government. About 300 years ago, it was the center of the , which was formed by the Vinsmoke Family's conquest of the North Blue. Today, the kingdom remains under Vinsmoke rule, and is serviced militarily as the Underworld army known as Germa 66.

In an attempt to retake control of the North Blue, King Vinsmoke Judge bartered with the Emperor Big Mom to form an alliance between his kingdom and the Big Mom Pirates in exchange for the Germa Kingdom's advanced technology, and attempted to seal the pact by marrying off his estranged son, Sanji, to Big Mom's 35th daughter, Charlotte Pudding. The Germa Kingdom was assembled at Whole Cake Island in the New World, but then later departed after Big Mom revealed her treachery. The World Government later disassociated themselves from the Germa Kingdom for attempting to ally themselves with the Big Mom Pirates.

The Germa Kingdom was first mentioned by Vinsmoke Reiju, who describes it as "a nation without land." Its "territory" is later shown to be comprised of platforms surrounded by railings that are built on the shells of large snails resembling Den Den Mushi. Those snails are seemingly unaffected by the salty sea and are strong enough to climb the Red Line. These ships usually move independently, depending on the kingdom's activities at the time, but can be interlocked as they come together to form the kingdom's "proper shape." As a consequence, the size and the bounds of the kingdom's territory are constantly fluctuating, depending on how many of its ships are assembled at one time.

The Germa Kingdom was once a member nation within the World Government, which allows them the privileges of an affiliated kingdom; this includes the right to attend the Levely. The kingdom's royal family also has an unusual pull over the legal system, being able to affect the bounty system and to issue direct commands to the Marines. However, after the incident in Totto Land, they lost all the privileges.
